Sam Rivers: Quick sync - vendors asked for a consolidated publish rehearsal for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi. Target Thu 10am PT. Need image digests + SI smoke by Wed EOD.
Priya Nair: noted. Which marketplaces? AWS/GCP/Azure all at once or stagger?
Sam Rivers: aim for simultaneous if all green; otherwise AWS then GCP then Azure with 30m gaps.
Diego Rivera: Gaudi kernel backport still on PR review. If not merged by Wed 8pm we pull Gaudi from initial publish.
Lina Wu: Marketing wants embargo contacts + hero assets by Wed 11am. Also two headline variants in case MI300 drops.
Priya Nair: partners asked for a +2h verification window for MI300 after dry-run. OK?
Sam Rivers: fine, add to runbook. Eng-Infra: can you simulate publish rollback Tue 9am PT?
partner-bot: Marketplace status: aws-h100 ready, gcp-h100 ready, azure-h100 pending; mi300: aws pending QAT, gcp ready; gaudi: kernel pending. Dry-run scheduled: 2025-05-15 10:00PT.
Diego Rivera: pinged Habana about the backport urgency.
Lina Wu: prepping alternate copy. Will share by Wed morning.
Sam Rivers: action list sent. Please confirm by Wed EOD or we adjust the cadence.
